decisionsTitle: The guide covers the October releases: the hourly limit and the Gmail road, the bulk resend, the chosen offers, the places line, the numbers column (amending §441)
decisionsSection:
**Amends §441.** The owner, 2026-10-01, on the race's first day of registrations, from his phone: «Trebuie să actualizăm și documentația live pt voluntari». Three releases had shipped or were shipping that night — the outbox's hourly pace for Mailgun (§605), the bulk resend of the declaration (§606) and the batch with the chosen offers, the places line and the numbers column (§610, §612–§617) — and «Ghid» said nothing of any of them. Of the chosen offers he had said the same morning: «Basically I wanna hand pick people from the waiting list and give them a seat».

**Decision.** «Ghid» (`/admin/guide`, `Admin.guide` in both catalogues) describes exactly what this tree does, as §441's jobs — a title and short numbered steps, the screen's own words in «…», roles never people — and nothing that is not built (no Gmail takeover, no public delay notice, no page for a replaced link).

- **«Planul Mailgun, înainte și după cursă»** (Administrator) is rewritten to match the screen: the plan dropdown and the note; «Limita pe oră» — how many leave through Mailgun in an hour, the rest waiting in the queue and none lost, 90 while Mailgun keeps the account limited (the box's own help), raised or cleared once the limit is lifted; «Salvează planul», after which «Costuri», «Trimise în ultima oră:» and «Trimite acum» follow it; «Prin ce pleacă emailurile: Mailgun sau Gmail-ul clubului», the road per group, with «Limita Gmail pe zi (destinatari)», the pause and «Salvează drumurile»; and after the race, Free again.
- **«Emailurile întârzie sau Mailgun a refuzat»** (new, Administrator): where to read «Trimise în ultima oră:» and «În coadă:», what a red «Întârziat…» row means, how a pause Mailgun asked for shows («Ultimul răspuns al furnizorului:» starting "paused by the provider") and that it spends no attempt, when «Trimite acum» helps (Gmail's road, an hour with room) and when it cannot, what to tell participants (Spam and Promotions), and when to write to the club's owner (a row «Oprit după toate încercările», red rows still there an hour later, a last hour stuck at 0 while the queue grows). Only verbs the Administrator has.
- **«Retrimite declarația celor care nu au semnat»** (new, Administrator): the event's «Înscrierile primite» → «Retrimite declarația tuturor care nu au semnat», the dialog's counts and who is skipped, the «La coadă:» banner, three presses an hour, the "i" that says why a press would be refused, and the two warnings — the earlier link stops working, and people should look in Spam and Promotions. The single resend stays «Retrimite emailul» on the registration's page.
- **«Alege tu cine primește un loc eliberat»** (new, Administrator, after «Deschide înscrierile la o cursă»): set «Ofertele din lista de așteptare pleacă automat» to «Nu» *before* raising «Număr de locuri», by as many places as are about to be handed out; «Trimite-i oferta» on a waiting row of «Coada de înscrieri» or on the registration's page; the ordinary «S-a eliberat un loc» email with the club's offer deadline and its «Confirmă locul»; a lapsed offer frees the place again; a free place is needed and the "i" says why a press would be refused; after the close the desk's «Dă-i un loc», with the person there, on paper; what the others see («Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare», newcomers queueing while anyone waits, «Lungimea maximă a listei de așteptare»); and the end of the line — once nobody is `WAITLISTED`, the places still free go to the next newcomer (§617's own warning). «Deschide înscrierile la o cursă» names the setting, and the cancellation lines (the Administrator's, the participant's) say that on «Nu» the place stays free.
- **«Ce NU se poate face»** gains: nobody gets a place without their own signature — an offer is accepted and signed by the person from their email, and «Dă-i un loc» confirms only on the paper declaration signed at the desk. The race-day «Nu s-a înscris deloc» says a walk-in also queues when somebody is already waiting, and that «Dă-i un loc» needs a free place.
- **The Organizer.** «Vezi cine s-a înscris» gains why the event page's «105 înscriși din 150 de locuri — 86 de confirmați, 19 în curs de confirmare» and «Cine vine» differ (the occupied places against the people who asked to appear), and what «1 loc oferit din lista de așteptare» on the card is. «Descarcă și tipărește numerele de concurs» gains the «Nr.» column (after the new notice, for runners registered under it, numbers given only). «Ce face Administratorul, nu tu» names the bulk resend and «Trimite-i oferta».
- **The legal texts.** «Textele legale ale clubului» gains the step that switches the «Nr.» column on — the «GDPR» card → «Regenerează din șablon» → the draft → «Aprobă și publică» — with «—» for runners registered before it and the «Sarcini» → «Club» row until then. It sits beside the list-states line already there, in the task that walks the notice's approval.
- **The costs (§610).** «Setări» → «Costuri» → «Cât costă», and «Planul Vercel» → «Salvează planul Vercel», are one step of the Administrator's Mailgun task: the costs tab opens to the Administrator and the Vercel plan is `canManageClubSettings`, so it is not a Superadministrator's step, and the «Bugetul lunii» thresholds task stays as it was.
- **The participant (§614, §615, §617).** «Înscrierea, de la formular la codul QR» no longer says the declaration is «pe pagina care se deschide»: after the confirmation the page says it comes by email, and the email's «Semnează declarația» leads to the box «Am citit și accept declarația…» and «Semnează», which now says under the box what is missing. «Locul și termenele lui» says a place may come by itself or be chosen by the club, by the «S-a eliberat un loc» email. «O familie pe o singură adresă» says a family reserves nothing while anybody waits.
- «Primii pași» → the top bar's «Emailuri» names the hourly limit, the Gmail routes and the sending queue.

**How it is held.** `guide-words.test.ts` already holds every «…» to a label the screen shows in each language and the two guides to the same shape; a new case pins the four Administrator jobs and the new hard limit, each by its button words, in both languages, with no «Rol necesar» line. The "i" beside a refused button is an icon, not a string, so it is quoted „i” rather than «i». Gmail's «Promoții»/"Promotions" tab is Google's, not ours, and is left unquoted.

*Rejected:* a separate «Mailgun» section — the jobs belong to the Administrator, whose section the reader already opens; describing the Gmail takeover, the public delay notice and the replaced-link page, which other branches carry and this tree does not; quoting the places line as «…» — its catalogue value begins with a placeholder, so it is quoted „…” as an example; and shortening any task that is still true.
changelogLine: - **«Ghid» covers the October releases** — the Mailgun plan's job walks the hourly limit, the Gmail routes and «Cât costă»; three new Administrator jobs say what to do when emails are late or Mailgun refused, how to resend the declaration to everyone who has not signed, and how to choose who gets a freed place; the Organizer's jobs explain the event page's places line and the «Nr.» column, and the participant's steps say the declaration comes by email. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Criterion 38 (addition): the guide carries, in both languages, the Administrator's jobs «Emailurile întârzie sau Mailgun a refuzat», «Retrimite declarația celor care nu au semnat» and «Alege tu cine primește un loc eliberat», each naming its screen's button, and «Planul Mailgun, înainte și după cursă» names «Limita pe oră», the Gmail routes and «Cât costă»; none opens with «Rol necesar». «Ce NU se poate face» says nobody gets a place without their own signature: an offer is accepted and signed by the person, and the desk's «Dă-i un loc» confirms only on the paper declaration they sign. Verification: unit `staff/guide-words.test.ts` (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
